query:
SELECT 
  SUM(cat9) as cat9_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cat9 > 0 THEN cat9 ELSE 0 END) as cat9_com_valor,
  COUNT(*) as total_dias,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN cat9 > 0 THEN 1 END) as dias_com_dpote,
  data
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND data LIKE '2026-07%' AND cat9 > 0
ORDER BY data;
